governance_interpretation: Class A shares carry voting rights; Class C shares are non-voting.
Company Units held by Ripple and the Larsen Lam trust carry economic rights but generally do not confer Pubco voting rights.
The SBI Group has substantial voting influence through 39.9% of Class A, while its share-count economic exposure across Class A and C is approximately 21.64%.
Arrington's 91% of Class C gives it very large non-voting share-count exposure, while its Class A stake is 19.9%.
The 85% tax receivable agreement creates future economic obligations to related parties.

custody_and_treasury_operations.bitgo_use_restriction: The Company says BitGo may not pledge, lend or otherwise use XRP unless expressly directed as part of Evernorth's yield-generation strategies.
custody_and_treasury_operations.additional_custodians: Evernorth says it may engage additional custodians in the future to diversify counterparty and operational exposure.

yield_and_collateral_status.rlusd_role: The prospectus says Evernorth intends to use RLUSD as a stable-value asset in XRP-based DeFi activity, including RLUSD/XRP AMM pools.
yield_and_collateral_status.unresolved_reconciliation: The prospectus says yield strategies and DeFi participation commenced following the October 9 closing, while also stating that 100% of XRP was in cold storage as of October 30. These statements may coexist if early activity involved derivative overlays or limited/non-material activity, but the filing does not disclose deployed token amounts, counterparties, collateral or on-chain positions. Do not infer that XRP lending, collateralization or AMM deployment has occurred at a material scale.

historical_financial_and_operational_con.caveat: These are pre-close historical financial figures, not a post-close November 5 balance sheet. The large net loss was primarily attributed to digital-asset impairment and fair-value changes in refundable investor advances; it is not equivalent to cash outflow.
